sections.title: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland

rows.label: Personal income tax: state income tax on earned income (valtion tulovero) [national]
rows.value: 12.64% to 37.5% in five bands from EUR 0 to above EUR 52,100 of taxable earned income (2026). Paid by resident individuals. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992; laki vuoden 2026 tuloveroasteikosta.
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: state-tax

source.title: Eduskunta: Eduskunnan vastaus EV 120/2025 vp, Laki vuoden 2026 tuloveroasteikosta

rows.label: Additional tax on pension income (high-pension surcharge) (eläketulon lisävero) [national]
rows.value: 5.85% of pension income above EUR 60,000. Paid by pensioners with pension income above EUR 60,000. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 124 a §.
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: state-tax-rules

source.title: Verohallinto: Veroperusteet 2026

rows.label: Municipal income tax (kunnallisvero) [municipal]
rows.value: 4.70% to 10.90% in mainland Finland, 17.00% to 19.70% in Åland (2026); average 7.60%. Paid by residents (non-residents on progressive taxation pay the 7.60% average). Tuloverolaki 1535/1992; Verohallinnon päätös kuntien tuloveroprosenteista 2026.
rows.note: Checklist item A3; detailed table: municipal-tax

rows.label: Church tax (kirkollisvero) [municipal]
rows.value: set by each parish (rates on the region pages); German parish 1.10%, Olaus Petri 1.00%. Paid by members of the Evangelical Lutheran and Orthodox churches. Kirkkolaki; Verohallinnon päätös seurakuntien tuloveroprosenteista 2026.
rows.note: Checklist item A4; detailed table: church-tax

source.title: Verohallinto: Kuntien ja seurakuntien tuloveroprosentit vuonna 2026 (decision VH/6585/00.01.00/2025)

rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals (luovutusvoittovero (pääomatulovero)) [national]
rows.value: 30% of capital income up to EUR 30,000 and 34% above; deemed acquisition cost 20% (40% after 10 years). Paid by individuals selling shares, property and other assets. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 46 § and 124 §.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: Verohallinto: Selling shares (page last updated 26 March 2026)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (ennakonpidätys osingoista; lähdevero) [national]
rows.value: residents: 25.5% withheld on listed-company dividends, 7.5% (28% above EUR 150,000) on unlisted; non-residents: 30% (individuals), 20% (identified corporate entities), 35% (unidentified nominee holders). Paid by recipients (withheld by the payer). Ennakkoperintälaki; laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978, 7 §.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (vuokratulo; eläketulo) [national]
rows.value: net rental income is capital income at 30% (34% above EUR 30,000); pensions are earned income, with the 5.85% surtax above EUR 60,000. Paid by landlords; pensioners. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992.

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (lähdevero) [national]
rows.value: 35% tax at source after a deduction of EUR 510 a month (EUR 17 a day); EU/EEA and treaty residents may opt for progressive taxation. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978, 6 § and 7 §.

rows.label: Social insurance contributions: earnings-related pension (TyEL), unemployment and health insurance (sosiaalivakuutusmaksut) [national]
rows.value: TyEL 24.4% in total (employee 7.30%, employer 17.10% on average); unemployment and health insurance on top (social-security sections above). Paid by employees and employers. Työntekijän eläkelaki 395/2006; sairausvakuutuslaki.

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (YEL pension insurance) (yrittäjän eläkevakuutus (YEL)) [national]
rows.value: 24.40% of confirmed work income (EUR 9,423.09 to 214,000 in 2026). Paid by self-employed persons with work income of at least EUR 9,423.09. Yrittäjän eläkelaki 1272/2006.
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: self-employed-contributions

source.title: Eläketurvakeskus (Finnish Centre for Pensions): FAQs on YEL insurance

rows.label: Contractor rules: employee or self-employed, and withholding on payments for work (ennakkoperintärekisteri) [national]
rows.value: no withholding when the seller is in the prepayment register; otherwise 13% for companies and partnerships, the tax-card rate or 60% for individuals. Paid by customers paying for work or services. Ennakkoperintälaki 1118/1996.

rows.label: Earnings-related occupational pension insurance (TyEL) (työeläkevakuutus) [national]
rows.value: 24.4% of wages on average in 2026. Paid by employers (with the employee's share withheld from pay). Työntekijän eläkelaki 395/2006.

rows.label: Corporate income tax (yhteisövero) [national]
rows.value: 20%; 15% domestic top-up tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by limited companies, cooperatives and other corporate entities. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 124 §; laki suurten konsernien vähimmäisverosta 1308/2023.

rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regime for the self-employed (yksinkertaistettu verotus) [national]
rows.value: None: business income is split into capital income (20% return on net worth) and earned income under the ordinary rules. Paid by no one. Elinkeinotulon verottamisesta annettu laki; tuloverolaki 38 §.
rows.note: Checklist item C3

source.title: Verohallinto: Instructions for filing (self-employed individuals)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits (lähdevero osingoista) [national]
rows.value: no separate tax on distributions; 20% tax at source on dividends to identified foreign corporate entities (lower under treaties or EU law); branches taxed at 20% as permanent establishments. Paid by foreign corporate shareholders (withheld by the payer); branches pay corporate tax. Laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978.

source.title: Verohallinto: Your tax handbook in Finland (page last updated 14 April 2026)

rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (arvonlisävero) [national]
rows.value: 25.5% standard, 13.5% and 10% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by registered businesses). Arvonlisäverolaki 1501/1993.

rows.value: spirits 56.28 cents per cl of ethyl alcohol; cigarettes 11.05 cents each + 52% of the retail price (11.59 cents from 1 July 2026); beverage containers outside the deposit system EUR 0.51 per litre. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Laki alkoholijuomaverosta; laki tupakkaverosta; laki eräiden juomapakkausten valmisteverosta.

rows.value: 25.5% of the premium for terms starting from 1 September 2024 (24% before). Paid by insurers (or the policyholder for foreign insurance), passed on in premiums. Laki vakuutusmaksuverosta 664/1966.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: excise

rows.label: Energy taxation: electricity tax and fuel taxes (sähkövero; energiaverot) [national]
rows.value: electricity 2.24 cents/kWh (class I) or 0.05 cents/kWh (class II), plus a 0.085 cents/kWh strategic stockpile fee. Paid by electricity and fuel suppliers (passed on in prices). Laki sähkön ja eräiden polttoaineiden valmisteverosta 1260/1996.

Paid by owners of real estate on 1 January. Kiinteistöverolaki 654/1992.

rows.label: Transfer tax on property and securities (varainsiirtovero) [national]
rows.value: 3% on real estate; 1.5% on housing company shares and other securities; no first-home exemption since 1 January 2024. Paid by the buyer. Varainsiirtoverolaki 931/1996.

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (perintö- ja lahjavero) [national]
rows.value: inheritance from EUR 30,000: 7% to 19% (bracket 1) or 19% to 33% (bracket 2); gifts from EUR 7,500 in three years: 8% to 17% or 19% to 33%. Paid by heirs and recipients of gifts. Perintö- ja lahjaverolaki 378/1940.

rows.label: Car tax on first registration (vehicle tax) (autovero) [national]
rows.value: a share of the general retail value that depends on the CO2 emissions. Paid by the person registering a car, van or motorcycle in Finland. Autoverolaki 1482/1994.

rows.value: e.g. coal EUR 147.81 per tonne and natural gas EUR 12.94 per MWh (from 1 April 2026), on top of the energy content tax. Paid by suppliers of fossil fuels (passed on in prices). Laki sähkön ja eräiden polttoaineiden valmisteverosta 1260/1996.

rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: state-tax

rows.label: Personal income tax: state income tax on earned income (valtion tulovero) [national]
rows.value: 12.64% to 37.5% in five bands from EUR 0 to above EUR 52,100 of taxable earned income (2026). Paid by resident individuals. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992; laki vuoden 2026 tuloveroasteikosta.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: state-tax-rules
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Veroperusteet 2026
rows.label: Additional tax on pension income (high-pension surcharge) (eläketulon lisävero) [national]
rows.value: 5.85% of pension income above EUR 60,000. Paid by pensioners with pension income above EUR 60,000. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 124 a §.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A3; detailed table: municipal-tax
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Kuntien ja seurakuntien tuloveroprosentit vuonna 2026 (decision VH/6585/00.01.00/2025)
rows.label: Municipal income tax (kunnallisvero) [municipal]
rows.value: 4.70% to 10.90% in mainland Finland, 17.00% to 19.70% in Åland (2026); average 7.60%. Paid by residents (non-residents on progressive taxation pay the 7.60% average). Tuloverolaki 1535/1992; Verohallinnon päätös kuntien tuloveroprosenteista 2026.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland

rows.label: Church tax (kirkollisvero) [municipal]
rows.value: set by each parish (rates on the region pages); German parish 1.10%, Olaus Petri 1.00%. Paid by members of the Evangelical Lutheran and Orthodox churches. Kirkkolaki; Verohallinnon päätös seurakuntien tuloveroprosenteista 2026.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Selling shares (page last updated 26 March 2026)
rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals (luovutusvoittovero (pääomatulovero)) [national]
rows.value: 30% of capital income up to EUR 30,000 and 34% above; deemed acquisition cost 20% (40% after 10 years). Paid by individuals selling shares, property and other assets. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 46 § and 124 §.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Tax at source on dividend, interest and royalty income (page last updated 27 October 2026)
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (ennakonpidätys osingoista; lähdevero) [national]
rows.value: residents: 25.5% withheld on listed-company dividends, 7.5% (28% above EUR 150,000) on unlisted; non-residents: 30% (individuals), 20% (identified corporate entities), 35% (unidentified nominee holders). Paid by recipients (withheld by the payer). Ennakkoperintälaki; laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978, 7 §.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (vuokratulo; eläketulo) [national]
rows.value: net rental income is capital income at 30% (34% above EUR 30,000); pensions are earned income, with the 5.85% surtax above EUR 60,000. Paid by landlords; pensioners. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident
rows.source_title: Verohallinto, detailed guidance: Taxation of income received by nonresidents – natural persons (issued 7 August 2026)
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (lähdevero) [national]
rows.value: 35% tax at source after a deduction of EUR 510 a month (EUR 17 a day); EU/EEA and treaty residents may opt for progressive taxation. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978, 6 § and 7 §.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: employee-contributions

rows.label: Social insurance contributions: earnings-related pension (TyEL), unemployment and health insurance (sosiaalivakuutusmaksut) [national]
rows.value: TyEL 24.4% in total (employee 7.30%, employer 17.10% on average); unemployment and health insurance on top (social-security sections above). Paid by employees and employers. Työntekijän eläkelaki 395/2006; sairausvakuutuslaki.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: self-employed-contributions
rows.source_title: Eläketurvakeskus (Finnish Centre for Pensions): FAQs on YEL insurance
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (YEL pension insurance) (yrittäjän eläkevakuutus (YEL)) [national]
rows.value: 24.40% of confirmed work income (EUR 9,423.09 to 214,000 in 2026). Paid by self-employed persons with work income of at least EUR 9,423.09. Yrittäjän eläkelaki 1272/2006.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Prepayment register (page last updated 27 February 2026)
rows.label: Contractor rules: employee or self-employed, and withholding on payments for work (ennakkoperintärekisteri) [national]
rows.value: no withholding when the seller is in the prepayment register; otherwise 13% for companies and partnerships, the tax-card rate or 60% for individuals. Paid by customers paying for work or services. Ennakkoperintälaki 1118/1996.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: employer-contributions
rows.source_title: Eläketurvakeskus (Finnish Centre for Pensions): Työeläkemaksut vuonna 2026
rows.label: Earnings-related occupational pension insurance (TyEL) (työeläkevakuutus) [national]
rows.value: 24.4% of wages on average in 2026. Paid by employers (with the employee's share withheld from pay). Työntekijän eläkelaki 395/2006.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Rates for corporate income tax (page last updated 1 January 2026)
rows.label: Corporate income tax (yhteisövero) [national]
rows.value: 20%; 15% domestic top-up tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by limited companies, cooperatives and other corporate entities. Tuloverolaki 1535/1992, 124 §; laki suurten konsernien vähimmäisverosta 1308/2023.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item C3
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Instructions for filing (self-employed individuals)
rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regime for the self-employed (yksinkertaistettu verotus) [national]
rows.value: None: business income is split into capital income (20% return on net worth) and earned income under the ordinary rules. Paid by no one. Elinkeinotulon verottamisesta annettu laki; tuloverolaki 38 §.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Your tax handbook in Finland (page last updated 14 April 2026)
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits (lähdevero osingoista) [national]
rows.value: no separate tax on distributions; 20% tax at source on dividends to identified foreign corporate entities (lower under treaties or EU law); branches taxed at 20% as permanent establishments. Paid by foreign corporate shareholders (withheld by the payer); branches pay corporate tax. Laki rajoitetusti verovelvollisen tulon verottamisesta 627/1978.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Your tax handbook in Finland (VAT)
rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (arvonlisävero) [national]
rows.value: 25.5% standard, 13.5% and 10% reduced. Paid by consumers (charged by registered businesses). Arvonlisäverolaki 1501/1993.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Excise duty table for alcohol and alcoholic beverages (page last updated 11 June 2026)
rows.label: Excise duties on alcohol, tobacco and beverage containers (valmisteverot) [national]
rows.value: spirits 56.28 cents per cl of ethyl alcohol; cigarettes 11.05 cents each + 52% of the retail price (11.59 cents from 1 July 2026); beverage containers outside the deposit system EUR 0.51 per litre. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Laki alkoholijuomaverosta; laki tupakkaverosta; laki eräiden juomapakkausten valmisteverosta.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Insurance premium taxation (page last updated 13 January 2026)
rows.label: Insurance premium tax (vakuutusmaksuvero) [national]
rows.value: 25.5% of the premium for terms starting from 1 September 2024 (24% before). Paid by insurers (or the policyholder for foreign insurance), passed on in premiums. Laki vakuutusmaksuverosta 664/1966.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Tax rates on electricity and certain fuels (page last updated 25 March 2026)
rows.label: Energy taxation: electricity tax and fuel taxes (sähkövero; energiaverot) [national]
rows.value: electricity 2.24 cents/kWh (class I) or 0.05 cents/kWh (class II), plus a 0.085 cents/kWh strategic stockpile fee. Paid by electricity and fuel suppliers (passed on in prices). Laki sähkön ja eräiden polttoaineiden valmisteverosta 1260/1996.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Value of real estate and real estate tax rates (page last updated 31 March 2026)
rows.label: Real estate tax (property tax) (kiinteistövero) [municipal]
rows.value: taxable value × the municipality's rate: ground 1.30–2.00%, permanent homes 0.41–1.00%, other residential 0.93–2.00%, other buildings 0.93–2.00%, unbuilt sites 2.00–6.00% (every municipality's 2026 rates on the region pages). Paid by owners of real estate on 1 January. Kiinteistöverolaki 654/1992.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Transfer tax (page last updated 7 January 2026)
rows.label: Transfer tax on property and securities (varainsiirtovero) [national]
rows.value: 3% on real estate; 1.5% on housing company shares and other securities; no first-home exemption since 1 January 2024. Paid by the buyer. Varainsiirtoverolaki 931/1996.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item E3
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Your tax handbook in Finland (page last updated 14 April 2026)
rows.label: Wealth tax (varallisuusvero) [national]
rows.value: None: 'Wealth tax: Not in use'. Paid by no one. Verohallinto, Your tax handbook in Finland.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance-gift
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Inheritance tax calculator and tax tables (page last updated 31 December 2025)
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (perintö- ja lahjavero) [national]
rows.value: inheritance from EUR 30,000: 7% to 19% (bracket 1) or 19% to 33% (bracket 2); gifts from EUR 7,500 in three years: 8% to 17% or 19% to 33%. Paid by heirs and recipients of gifts. Perintö- ja lahjaverolaki 378/1940.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item F1
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Amount of car tax and car tax calculator (page last updated 30 July 2024)
rows.label: Car tax on first registration (vehicle tax) (autovero) [national]
rows.value: a share of the general retail value that depends on the CO2 emissions. Paid by the person registering a car, van or motorcycle in Finland. Autoverolaki 1482/1994.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Tax rates on electricity and certain fuels (page last updated 25 March 2026)
rows.label: Carbon dioxide tax in energy taxation (hiilidioksidivero) [national]
rows.value: e.g. coal EUR 147.81 per tonne and natural gas EUR 12.94 per MWh (from 1 April 2026), on top of the energy content tax. Paid by suppliers of fossil fuels (passed on in prices). Laki sähkön ja eräiden polttoaineiden valmisteverosta 1260/1996.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382 of 11 February 2026 amending Regulation (EC) No 1186/2009 as regards the elimination of the threshold-based customs duty relief (EUR-Lex)
rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and travel allowances (tulli, tuonnin arvonlisävero) [EU]

rows.note: Checklist item H2; detailed table: yle-tax

rows.value: 2.5% of net income above EUR 15,150, at most EUR 160; Åland media fee EUR 128. Paid by residents aged 18 or over. Laki Yleisradioverosta 484/2012.

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers

rows.label: Key employees from abroad: 25% tax at source (expat regime) (avainhenkilölaki) [national]

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge in Finland

rows.source_title: Verohallinto: Sosiaalivakuutusmaksut (page last updated 8.12.2025)
